definitions.explanation: The person or thing at the centre of an activity, on which the rest depends: a team's key player, a company's core business.
In machines and geometry, the principal shaft or axis, such as the spindle of a machine tool.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主軸|しゅじく}だ。
examples.english: He is the mainstay of the team.

examples.japanese: ⟦{輸出|ゆしゅつ}→輸出：02094_yushutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主軸|しゅじく}になっている。
examples.english: Exports have become the core of the business.

examples.japanese: {四番|よばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧{主軸|しゅじく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦けが→けが：00787_kega⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}けた→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{打線|だせん}→打線：30021_dasen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{組|く}み{替|か}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迫|せま}られた→迫る：03928_semaru⟧。
examples.english: With its cleanup-hitting mainstay out injured, the team was forced to reshuffle its batting order.

examples.japanese: ⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主軸|しゅじく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{曲|ま}がった→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧。
{主軸|しゅじく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{回転|かいてん}→回転：00141_kaiten⟧⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{旋盤|せんばん}→旋盤：26174_senban⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{主軸|しゅじく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{付|つ}けた→取り付ける：06797_toritsukeru⟧⟦{材料|ざいりょう}→材料：02831_zairyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}し→回す：01158_mawasu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{削|けず}って→削る：03922_kezuru⟧いく。

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is the common one, in news and sports: {主軸|しゅじく}⟦{打者|だしゃ}→打者：06564_dasha⟧ (a team's key batters, often the third to fifth in the order), {主軸|しゅじく}⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧ (core business), 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{主軸|しゅじく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{据|す}える→据える：12796_sueru⟧ (to make ~ the mainstay).

- ⟦{柱|はしら}→柱：05009_hashira⟧: pillar; a mainstay in the figurative sense too (⟦{一家|いっか}→一家：01723_ikka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{柱|はしら}→柱：05009_hashira⟧, the family's breadwinner)
